name: Does commercial disaster recovery include mold remediation?

mainEntity.name: Does commercial disaster recovery include mold remediation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, commercial disaster recovery often includes mold remediation, especially after water-related incidents. If water damage is not promptly and thoroughly dried, mold can begin to grow within 24-48 hours. Professional disaster recovery services will assess for mold, contain affected areas, remove mold colonies using specialized techniques, and apply treatments to prevent recurrence. Addressing mold is crucial for both property integrity and the health of occupants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, mold remediation is often included in commercial disaster recovery, especially after water damage, to ensure property and occupant health.
